policy: For each ISO/ROI/CFA phase select coordinates in pre-RCD top16 centered absolute residual at least twice across original development pairs ONLY. Freeze selected mask before reading control pixels. Score identical coordinates on all retained development/control pairs, including empty masks. Temporal variance from frame-centered phase fields within subset; compare selected sites with whole-phase median and nonselected8 neighbors on phase grid. No choice based on control, no masking/correction, no new threshold calibration. Uses cached20 frames, no unpaired sources, no RAW decode or final reserve access.
